# Calculator backlog

Generated from `src/calculators/backlog.ts` by `npm run backlog:report`. Do not edit by hand.

Priority = 2 × usefulness + 2 × demand − difficulty (each scored 1–5). Scores are editorial estimates; demand is not yet backed by search-volume data.

**Unit converters** are tracked separately in `docs/unit-converters.md` (generated by `npm run converters:report`). The length, weight, volume, temperature, area, speed and data storage converters listed here are reused by the `/unit-converters` directory rather than duplicated. Concepts that the converter directory already serves (pressure, energy, power, time, angle, fuel economy, number base, Roman numeral, Unix timestamp, colour code, text to binary and Morse code) were removed from this calculator backlog to avoid duplicate pages.

**Topic research.** Concepts marked with a reference were found in web-search listings of Omni Calculator category pages (15 October 2026). Those pages could not be opened from the build environment, and Omni lists about 3,800 calculators, so its directory has **not** been reviewed in full. References are used for topic discovery only. Formulas are implemented independently, and all page text is original.
